answer: Every agent identity gets a tide-pool liquidity lock: $200 staked in one unique pool slot, unlocking after 180 verified days. First, the agent locks funds and claims one pool. Second, fees start only after 30 peer-checked jobs. Third, audits check its work; a proven fake drains the pool and blacklists the slot 2 years. Forging 10,000 fakes locks $2,000,000 for six months and demands 300,000 verified jobs. A gale of fakes breaks on the rock sheltering honest ones, and like a tundra fox returning to one den each winter, a real agent keeps one home, not a thousand burrows in the ocean.
